title: For your next cup

modes.personal: Suggestions from your saved brew preferences, equipment and bean inventory. Each card explains its match and what is still unknown.
modes.explore: Exploring your selected method and taste. These choices are temporary and do not overwrite your account preferences.
modes.discovery: Start with the published catalog. Add your equipment and preferences for personal matches; these are discovery suggestions, not a taste prediction.

filterNote: These controls change this visit only. Equipment comes from My equipment; saved taste preferences come from onboarding.

warnings.catalog: Some catalog data could not be loaded. The results below may be incomplete; this is not an empty-catalog confirmation.
warnings.profile: Some account preferences could not be loaded. Personalization is limited to the information available in this request.
warnings.evidence: Some equipment or community evidence could not be loaded. Missing evidence is not treated as a positive result.

scope: This request examined {coffees} coffee records and {recipes} public recipes.
limited: A source reached its safety limit. Catalog reads cover up to {limit} recent records per table; personal and community evidence are also bounded. These are not whole-catalog rankings.
noCoffee: No reviewed coffee matches this brew method. Try another method or add more reviewed catalog data.
noRecipes: No public recipes match the selected method or your registered brewing gear.
noMatch: Published catalog discovery; no direct personal match was found.

reasons.method: Matches your chosen or saved brew method
reasons.gearMethod: Your registered brewing equipment supports this method
reasons.flavor: Matches a recorded flavor family you selected
reasons.inventory: This coffee is recorded in your active bean inventory
reasons.exactEquipment: The listed recipe equipment matches your registered gear
reasons.ownSuccess: Your latest recorded attempt with this recipe had a good outcome
reasons.community: Supported by positive outcomes from at least three distinct brewers

caveats.stockUnknown: Catalog bean only: stock and a purchasable bag are not verified.
caveats.stale: Verification is over 90 days old. Recheck the source before relying on current availability.
caveats.unverified: No valid past verification date is recorded.
caveats.equipmentUnknown: Brewing gear is not registered; equipment compatibility is not confirmed.
caveats.equipmentDifferent: Some listed equipment differs or is missing. Do not transfer grinder numbers between different models.
caveats.incomplete: Recipe or equipment details are incomplete. Review the full recipe before brewing.
caveats.communityLimited: Community evidence is insufficient for a positive-outcome recommendation.

recordedStock: Last recorded stock: {status}. Check the product source before buying.
observed: Observed outcomes: {successful} positive out of {total} distinct brewers with an outcome.
how: A deterministic matching engine uses brew method, registered equipment, documented flavor families, roast preference, active inventory and your own recorded brew results. Community boosts count distinct brewers and exclude saves without brewing. Missing data gives no positive evidence. Internal ordering weights are not displayed as AI confidence or a probability. No new grinder settings, temperatures or recipes are invented, and no xBloom device is controlled. Private preferences are read for your signed-in account only, without a shared personalized cache.
